scenarios.description: SetStage order on VMS16 (objective-only result scripts): a stage set on a stopped quest, a lower stage after a higher one (GetStage, GetStageDone, whether the lower stage's script runs), the same stage again without the repeat flag, an undefined stage, a lower stage, and the Fail Quest stage. In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest_stage_order.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md section 4); fnvtool script run is workstream 5B's and errors until it lands.

A quest with 'Allow repeated stages' (Generic): stage 70's result script sets the global ScroungerOdds; the global is reset and the stage set again; then the lower stage 60 (GetStage after it). In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest_repeated_stage.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md section 4); fnvtool script run is workstream 5B's and errors until it lands.
